sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up portrait of an older man in a three-quarter view facing and gazing screen-left, with the screen-right ear visible. Very high receding hairline/nearly bare crown, short close brown-grey hair around the sides and greyer temples, dark-grey brows, no hat and no eyewear. Stern concentrated expression with furrowed brow and a closed unsmiling mouth; upper lip and chin are smooth, without a distinct moustache or beard. Dark brown civilian suit jacket with broad notched lapels, white pointed shirt collar and a very dark brown tie; shoulders and lower chest cropped by the rectangle. Preserve the short natural neck, collar opening/contact, outfit and warm upper-left facial light. Pale grey-beige painted background fills the entire rectangle, with no card, frame or note. Actual source alpha249..255 is visually solid and is not an instruction to remove the backing. Exact156x210 original, full nearest4x and mouth nearest10x crop actually viewed. Evidence limit: individual hair strands and fine fabric/seam texture are below exact-source resolution; no microscopic matching claim. visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.
